options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: villagers_required
options.description: How many Villagers you need to save in order to fight Barlowe.

options.name: starting_glyph
options.description:
Which Arm Glyph you start the game with.
Random Base selects any base-power Glyph.
You can additionanlly type in any valid Arm Glyph manually.
(ex. "Confodere = 1")

options.name: start_with_lizard_tail
options.description: If disabled, Lizard Tail will be shuffled into the item pool.

options.name: start_with_glyph_union
options.description: If disabled, Glyph Union will be shuffled into the item pool.

options.name: start_with_glyph_sleeve
options.description: If enabled, you'll start with the Glyph Sleeve.

options.name: starting_villagers
options.description: Specify which Villagers you want to start the game with.

options.name: shuffle_dominus
options.description: Shuffles the three Dominus glyphs into the item pool.

options.name: add_brown_chests
options.description:
Brown chest behavior.
Normal; Brown chests are untouched
Random Rewards; Shuffles the filler reward pool you get from brown chests
Include; Converts all brown chests to regular chests.

options.name: randomize_villagers
options.description:
How Villagers are placed.
Normal: Villagers are found in their normal locations.
Shuffled: Villagers are shuffled amongst each other
Anywhere: Villagers can be found anywhere.

options.name: starting_area
options.description: Which main Area you start with.

options.name: remove_training_hall
options.description: If enabled, Training Hall will never be accessible.

options.name: remove_large_cavern
options.description: If enabled, Large Cavern will never be accessible.

options.name: experience_percent
options.description: What percentage of EXP enemies give you. This is a percent of their original EXP amount.

options.name: reveal_map
options.description: Start with the entire map visible.

options.name: reveal_hidden_walls
options.description: Automatically reveals all breakable walls/objects.

options.name: reveal_hidden_chests
options.description: Hidden blue chests will automatically be revealed.

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
